### load the data 
```{r}
install.packages("GWmodel")

# Load packages
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(spatialreg)
library(GWmodel)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(broom)
```
### load the shapefile 
```{r}
philly <- st_read(
  "RegressionDataFiles.shp"
)
```
logaraithmic variables were already created in assignment 1, move onto next step

### Queen-contiguity spatial weights
```{r}
# Check the coordinate system
st_crs(philly)

# Repair invalid geometries if necessary
philly <- st_make_valid(philly)

# Create Queen-contiguity neighbors
queen_nb <- poly2nb(
  philly,
  queen = TRUE
)

# Create row-standardized spatial weights
queen_weights <- nb2listw(
  queen_nb,
  style = "W",
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Check the neighbor structure
summary(queen_nb)
summary(card(queen_nb))
```

### Global Moran's I for median house values 
```{r}
# Global Moran's I
moran.test(
  philly$LNMEDHVAL,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Randomization test with 999 permutations
set.seed(5080)

global_moran <- moran.mc(
  philly$LNMEDHVAL,
  queen_weights,
  nsim = 999,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
global_moran_res <- global_moran$res
hist(global_moran_res, freq = 10000000, nclass=100)
abline(v=moran(philly$LNMEDHVAL, queen_weights, n = length(queen_weights$neighbours), S0=Szero(queen_weights))$`I`, col='red')

```



### LISA: Local Moran's I 
```{r}

lisa <- localmoran(
  philly$LNMEDHVAL,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

philly$local_I <- lisa[, "Ii"]
philly$local_p <- lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

# Map local Moran's I p-values
tm_shape(philly) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "local_p",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
      values = c("darkblue", "blue", "lightblue", "pink"),
      labels = c("p < 0.001", "p < 0.01", "p < 0.05", "Not significant")
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "p-value")
  ) +
  tm_title("LISA P-Value Map: Median House Values")
```


```{r}
lisa <- localmoran(
  philly$LNMEDHVAL,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Attach local Moran statistics to the polygons
philly$local_I <- lisa[, "Ii"]
philly$local_p <- lisa[, "Pr(z != E(Ii))"]

# Standardize the variable and compute its spatial lag (neighbors' average)
philly$z_val <- as.numeric(scale(philly$LNMEDHVAL))
philly$lag_z <- lag.listw(queen_weights, philly$z_val, zero.policy = TRUE)

# Classify into quadrants, only where p < 0.05
sig <- 0.05
philly$cluster <- "Not significant"
philly$cluster[philly$z_val > 0 & philly$lag_z > 0 & philly$local_p < sig] <- "High-High"
philly$cluster[philly$z_val < 0 & philly$lag_z < 0 & philly$local_p < sig] <- "Low-Low"
philly$cluster[philly$z_val > 0 & philly$lag_z < 0 & philly$local_p < sig] <- "High-Low"
philly$cluster[philly$z_val < 0 & philly$lag_z > 0 & philly$local_p < sig] <- "Low-High"

philly$cluster <- factor(
  philly$cluster,
  levels = c("High-High", "Low-Low", "High-Low", "Low-High", "Not significant")
)

# Map the clusters
tm_shape(philly) +
  tm_polygons(
    "cluster",
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#2c7bb6", "#fdae61", "#abd9e9", "grey90"),
    title = "LISA Cluster",
    drop.levels = FALSE   # keep all categories in the legend
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    title = "LISA Clusters of Median House Values"
  )
```

### OLS Regression
```{r}
# Model formula
model_formula <- LNMEDHVAL ~
  PCTBACHMOR +
  PCTVACANT +
  PCTSINGLES +
  LNNBELPOV +
  MEDHHINC

# Fit OLS
ols_model <- lm(
  model_formula,
  data = philly
)

# Regression output
summary(ols_model)
```

### save the fitted values and residuals 
```{r}
philly$OLS_PRED <- fitted(ols_model)
philly$OLS_RESID <- residuals(ols_model)
```

### test OLS residuals for spatial autocorrelation 
```{r}
# Moran's I test for OLS residuals
moran.test(
  philly$OLS_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

set.seed(5080)

moran.mc(
  philly$OLS_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  nsim = 999,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)
```

### weighted residuals and scatterplot 
```{r}
philly$WT_RESID <- lag.listw(
  queen_weights,
  philly$OLS_RESID,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Regress residuals on neighboring residuals
resid_model <- lm(
  OLS_RESID ~ WT_RESID,
  data = philly
)

summary(resid_model)

# Scatterplot with fitted regression line
ggplot(
  st_drop_geometry(philly),
  aes(x = WT_RESID, y = OLS_RESID)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "OLS Residuals vs. Spatially Lagged Residuals",
    x = "Weighted Average of Neighboring OLS Residuals",
    y = "OLS Residuals"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### spatial lag model 
```{r}
lag_model <- lagsarlm(
  model_formula,
  data = philly,
  listw = queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE,
  method = "eigen"
)

summary(lag_model)
```

### save residuals and test for spatial autocorrelation 
```{r}
philly$LAG_RESID <- residuals(lag_model)

moran.test(
  philly$LAG_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

set.seed(5080)

moran.mc(
  philly$LAG_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  nsim = 999,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)
```

### run spatial error model
```{r}
error_model <- errorsarlm(
  model_formula,
  data = philly,
  listw = queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE,
  method = "eigen"
)

summary(error_model)
```

### test the residuals
```{r}
philly$ERROR_RESID <- residuals(error_model)

moran.test(
  philly$ERROR_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

set.seed(5080)

moran.mc(
  philly$ERROR_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  nsim = 999,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)
```

### compare the three regression models
```{r}
model_comparison <- tibble(
  Model = c("OLS", "Spatial Lag", "Spatial Error"),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(ols_model),
    AIC(lag_model),
    AIC(error_model)
  ),
  R_squared = c(
    summary(ols_model)$r.squared,
    NA_real_,
    NA_real_
  )
)

model_comparison
```

### run geographically weighted regression (GWR)
#### prepare data 
```{r}
# Project the data
philly_gwr <- st_set_crs(philly, 2272)

# Convert to Spatial format for GWmodel compatibility
philly_sp <- as(philly_gwr, "Spatial")

# Check coordinate system
st_crs(philly_gwr)
```

#### select bandwidth
```{r}
# Select bandwidth using AICc
gwr_bandwidth <- bw.gwr(
  model_formula,
  data = philly_sp,
  approach = "AICc",
  kernel = "bisquare",
  adaptive = TRUE
)

gwr_bandwidth
```

#### fit GWR
```{r}
gwr_model <- gwr.basic(
  model_formula,
  data = philly_sp,
  bw = gwr_bandwidth,
  kernel = "bisquare",
  adaptive = TRUE,
  F123.test = TRUE,
  cv = TRUE
)

# Global GWR diagnostics
gwr_model$GW.diagnostic
```

#### map local r-squared
```{r}
gwr_results <- st_as_sf(gwr_model$SDF)

names(gwr_results)
```

```{r}
ggplot(gwr_results) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Local_R2), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Local R-squared",
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Local R-squared from Geographically Weighted Regression"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### test GWR residuals for spatial autocorrelation
```{r}
names(gwr_results)

# Save GWR residuals
philly$GWR_RESID <- gwr_results$residual

# Global Moran's I
moran.test(
  philly$GWR_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# Permutation test
set.seed(5080)

gwr_moran <- moran.mc(
  philly$GWR_RESID,
  queen_weights,
  nsim = 999,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

gwr_moran
```

### map local coefficient to standard error ratios
```{r}
names(gwr_results)

# Example for one predictor
gwr_results <- gwr_results %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_PCTBACHMOR =
      PCTBACHMOR / PCTBACHMOR_SE
  )

gwr_results <- gwr_results %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_category = case_when(
      ratio_PCTBACHMOR < -2 ~ "Below -2",
      ratio_PCTBACHMOR < 0  ~ "-2 to 0",
      ratio_PCTBACHMOR <= 2 ~ "0 to 2",
      ratio_PCTBACHMOR > 2  ~ "Above 2",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ratio_category = factor(
      ratio_category,
      levels = c(
        "Below -2",
        "-2 to 0",
        "0 to 2",
        "Above 2"
      )
    )
  )

ggplot(gwr_results) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = ratio_category), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Below -2" = "darkred",
      "-2 to 0" = "pink",
      "0 to 2" = "lightblue",
      "Above 2" = "darkblue"
    ),
    na.value = "grey80",
    name = "Coefficient / SE"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Local Coefficient-to-SE Ratio: Bachelor's Degree"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### save results
```{r}
# Save shapefile with residuals
st_write(
  philly,
  "RegressionFinal_Results.shp",
  delete_layer = TRUE
)

# Save GWR local coefficients and diagnostics
st_write(
  gwr_results,
  "GWR_Results.shp",
  delete_layer = TRUE
)

# Save regression summaries to a text file
sink("Regression_Summaries.txt")

cat("OLS MODEL\n")
print(summary(ols_model))

cat("\nSPATIAL LAG MODEL\n")
print(summary(lag_model))

cat("\nSPATIAL ERROR MODEL\n")
print(summary(error_model))

cat("\nGWR DIAGNOSTICS\n")
print(gwr_model$GW.diagnostic)

sink()

saveRDS(
  list(
    ols = ols_model,
    spatial_lag = lag_model,
    spatial_error = error_model,
    gwr = gwr_model,
    comparison = model_comparison
  ),
  "Philadelphia_Regression_Models.rds"
)
```
